claims.statement: Quandrix is Strixhaven's green-blue College of Numeromancy.
The 2021 Strixhaven guide describes Quandrix mages as mathematician-mages who study patterns, fractals, and symmetries to command power over fundamental forces.
The 2021 guide frames Quandrix through a tension between mathematics as a force of nature to discover and mathematics as a mind-made tool to map reality.
The 2021 guide identifies fractals as Quandrix's mascots.
The 2026 guide lists Quandrix study areas including geometry, statistics, biology, physics, architecture, logic, and theoretical metaphysics.
Quandrix placement signals should weight pattern recognition, abstraction, proof, precision, systemic curiosity, and delight in difficult problems.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
